parameters.help_en:
The metric name.

For information about how to obtain metric names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98846.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html.

Note: For composite metrics, you can only search by the first metric

监控项名称。

关于如何获取监控项名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98846.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html。

parameters.help_en:
The enabled state of the alert rule. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled

true：启用。

parameters.help_en:

页码。
